deadlyWeapons.Name: Characters fight with deadly weapons
deadlyWeapons.Hint: Ironsworn: a deadly weapon (a sword, an axe, a spear, a bow) inflicts 2 harm, an unarmed attack or a simple weapon 1. On, characters strike for 2 harm (3 on a strong Strike); off, 1. Starforged doesn't use harm this way.
